title: Design a Notification System
summary: Design a scalable notification system supporting push, SMS, and email.
body:
Design a scalable notification system supporting push, SMS, and email.

## Scenario

Design a notification system that can send push notifications, SMS, and emails to millions of users.

## Requirements

- Support multiple channels: push (iOS/Android), SMS, email
- User notification preferences (opt-in/out per channel and type)
- Template-based notifications with personalization
- Scheduled and triggered notifications
- Delivery tracking and analytics

## Constraints

- Send 10M notifications per day
- Push notification delivery < 5 seconds
- At-least-once delivery guarantee
- Rate limiting per user (max 5 notifications per hour)

## What a strong answer covers

- Message queue architecture for reliability
- Priority queue for urgent notifications
- Template rendering pipeline
- Third-party service integration (APNs, FCM, Twilio, SendGrid)
- De-duplication strategy

## Reference walkthrough

Event-driven architecture with Kafka as the message backbone. Notification service receives events, resolves user preferences, and fans out to channel-specific queues. Each channel has dedicated workers with provider SDKs. Priority queue (separate Kafka topic) for urgent notifications. Template service with variable substitution. Redis for rate limiting and de-duplication (message ID tracking). DLQ for failed deliveries with exponential backoff retry. Analytics via event streaming to data warehouse.
keyTakeaways: Third-party service integration (APNs, FCM, Twilio, SendGrid)
